title: Lombok Private Driver — Hire a Car With Driver by the Day | FIRST-LOP
description: Hire a private driver in Lombok from $40 a day. Air-conditioned car, local English-speaking chauffeur, fuel and parking included, pickup from your hotel or Lombok Airport.
h1: Your own private driver in Lombok, for as long as you need.
intro: Lombok is bigger than it looks and public transport barely reaches the best beaches, waterfalls and villages. A private driver solves it: one car and one local chauffeur for your group, a route you control, and no waiting for shuttles or haggling with taxis.

sections.h2: How hiring a driver in Lombok works
sections.body: Tell us your dates, where you are staying and roughly what you want to see. We match you with a car sized for your group and a chauffeur who knows the route. On the day, your driver picks you up at your hotel, villa or Lombok International Airport (LOP) and stays with you for the whole day. Change plans as you go: stay longer at a beach, skip a stop, or ask for the warung locals actually eat at.

Couples usually take a compact Toyota Agya or Honda Brio. Families and groups of up to seven pick the Mitsubishi Xpander, Toyota Innova or Innova Zenix Hybrid. For special occasions, our flagship Toyota Alphard comes with captain seats and a premium cabin. Every car is air-conditioned and driven by a professional local chauffeur.

sections.h2: Popular day routes with a private driver
sections.body: South Lombok beaches (Selong Belanak, Tanjung Aan, Bukit Merese and Kuta Mandalika); the Senaru waterfalls Sendang Gile and Tiu Kelep at the foot of Mount Rinjani; the Sasak villages of Sade, Sukarara and Banyumulek; and transfers to Teluk Nare or Bangsal harbour for the Gili Islands.

highlights: Private air-conditioned car for your group only
Local, professional chauffeur who knows the island
Fuel, tolls and parking fees included
Pickup from your hotel, villa or Lombok Airport
Flexible route: change the plan on the day
No hidden booking fees

faqs.q: How much does a private driver in Lombok cost?
faqs.a: With FIRST-LOP, a car with a private driver starts from $40 a day for a compact car. Seven-seat cars such as the Xpander start from $60 a day, premium Innova Zenix models from $85, and the Toyota Alphard is $200 a day.

faqs.q: Is fuel included?
faqs.a: Yes. Fuel for your planned itinerary, road tolls and destination parking fees are included in your daily price.

faqs.q: Can the driver pick us up from Lombok Airport?
faqs.a: Yes. Your driver can meet you at the arrivals hall of Lombok International Airport (LOP), help with luggage and start your day straight from the airport.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book?
faqs.a: We recommend 24 to 48 hours ahead, and earlier in high season (July to September and the year-end holidays). Same-day requests are often possible depending on availability.

title: Lombok Airport Transfer (LOP) — Private Pickup to Kuta, Senggigi & Gili Harbours | FIRST-LOP
description: Private Lombok International Airport (LOP) transfers to Kuta Mandalika, Selong Belanak, Senggigi and the Gili Islands harbours. Name-board greeting, flight tracking and luggage help.
h1: Private transfers from Lombok International Airport (LOP).
intro: Land, walk out of arrivals, and find your driver waiting with your name. FIRST-LOP airport transfers take you straight from Lombok International Airport to your hotel, villa or harbour in a private air-conditioned car, with no queues and no taxi negotiations.

sections.h2: Where we drive from the airport
sections.body: Lombok International Airport sits in Central Lombok, close to the south coast. The most requested transfers are to Kuta Mandalika and Tanjung Aan, Selong Belanak and the southwest surf beaches, Senggigi on the west coast, and Teluk Nare or Bangsal harbour for boats to Gili Trawangan, Gili Meno and Gili Air.

sections.h2: What a FIRST-LOP airport transfer includes
sections.body: We track your flight, so a delay never leaves you stranded. Your driver greets you in the arrivals hall with a name board, helps with your luggage and drives you in a private car reserved only for your group. Chilled water is waiting in the car.

sections.h2: Turn your transfer into a first day
sections.body: Arriving early? Add a few stops on the way: lunch by the beach in Kuta, the Sasak village of Sade, or a sunset at Bukit Merese before check-in. Just tell us when you book.

highlights: Name-board greeting at LOP arrivals
Flight tracking for delays
Luggage assistance
Private air-conditioned car
Drop-off at hotels, villas and Gili harbours
Option to add sightseeing stops

faqs.q: Do you pick up from Lombok International Airport (LOP)?
faqs.a: Yes. Your driver meets you in the arrivals hall with a name board, helps with luggage and takes you directly to your accommodation or harbour.

faqs.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faqs.a: We monitor your flight, so your driver adjusts to your actual arrival time.

faqs.q: Can you take us from the airport to the Gili Islands?
faqs.a: We drive you to Teluk Nare or Bangsal harbour in North Lombok, where you can take a boat to the Gili Islands. We can also arrange a private boat charter.

faqs.q: Which car should I choose for a family with luggage?
faqs.a: For up to seven people with luggage, choose a seven-seat car such as the Xpander, Innova or Innova Zenix. For extra comfort, the Toyota Alphard has a premium cabin and captain seats.

title: Gili Islands Private Tour From Lombok — Private Boat, Turtles & Snorkelling | FIRST-LOP
description: Private Gili Islands day tour from Lombok: hotel pickup, private boat from Teluk Nare, snorkelling with sea turtles and the Gili Meno underwater statues. From $110 per private charter.
h1: The Gili Islands by private boat, without the crowded ferries.
intro: Gili Trawangan, Gili Meno and Gili Air are a short boat ride from Lombok's north coast. On a FIRST-LOP private tour, your driver takes you to the harbour and your own boat and captain take it from there: turtle reefs, the underwater statues and quiet beaches, on your schedule.

sections.body: Your private driver picks you up anywhere on mainland Lombok and drives you to Teluk Nare harbour. There, a private wooden outrigger boat and a local captain are reserved only for your group. You snorkel with wild green sea turtles, visit the underwater statues off Gili Meno, and stop on Gili Trawangan for lunch and a car-free bicycle ride before the boat returns you to your driver.

Public boats run on fixed timetables and fill up in high season. A private charter leaves when you are ready, goes where you want, and lets you stay longer at the best snorkel spots. It also suits families and couples who want a quiet day on the water.

sections.h2: Good to know before you go
sections.body: The day takes about 7 to 9 hours including the drive. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat and cash for lunch on the islands. Sea conditions are calmest in the morning, so we usually start early.

highlights: Hotel pickup anywhere on mainland Lombok
Private boat and captain for your group
Snorkelling with wild sea turtles
Gili Meno underwater statues
Lunch and bicycle ride on Gili Trawangan
Return to the mainland with your driver waiting

faqs.q: How much is a private Gili Islands tour from Lombok?
faqs.a: FIRST-LOP private Gili Islands tours start from $110 per private charter. Your exact quote depends on your group size and pickup location.

faqs.q: Which harbour do we leave from?
faqs.a: Private tours usually depart from Teluk Nare harbour in North Lombok. Your driver takes you there from your hotel or villa.

faqs.q: Can we see sea turtles?
faqs.a: Yes. Wild green sea turtles live on the reefs around the Gili Islands, and your captain takes you to the spots where they are most often seen.

faqs.q: Is snorkel gear included?
faqs.a: Tell us when you book and we will arrange snorkel gear for your group.

title: South Lombok Tour — Kuta, Tanjung Aan, Selong Belanak & Bukit Merese | FIRST-LOP
description: Private South Lombok beach tour with your own driver: Selong Belanak, Tanjung Aan, Kuta Mandalika and sunset at Bukit Merese. From $65 per vehicle for up to 4 guests.
h1: South Lombok's best beaches in one private day.
intro: The south coast is why most people fall for Lombok: wide white bays, green headlands and surf that rolls in all year. A private South Lombok tour links the best of it in one relaxed day, ending with sunset on the hill at Bukit Merese.

sections.body: Morning swim at Selong Belanak, the gentlest beach on the coast and a good place for first-time surfers. Lunch in Kuta Mandalika. Afternoon at Tanjung Aan's powdery sand and hidden coves. Finish on Bukit Merese for golden hour over the twin bays. The full day takes about 8 to 10 hours, and every stop can be changed.

sections.h2: Add the Sasak village of Sade
sections.body: On the way south, stop at Sade, a traditional Sasak hamlet with thatched houses and handwoven textiles. It adds about an hour and gives the beach day some local culture.
Beach lovers, photographers, families and surf beginners. If you are staying in Senggigi, Mataram or near the airport, this is the easiest way to see the south without renting a scooter.

highlights: Selong Belanak bay and beginner surf
Tanjung Aan's white sand coves
Kuta Mandalika lunch stop
Sunset on Bukit Merese
Optional stop at Sade Sasak village
Private car and driver all day

faqs.q: How much is a South Lombok tour?
faqs.a: The FIRST-LOP South Lombok Coastal & Beach tour starts from $65 per vehicle for up to 4 guests, with your own driver, fuel and parking included.

faqs.q: How long does the tour take?
faqs.a: A full South Lombok day takes about 8 to 10 hours, including the sunset stop at Bukit Merese.

faqs.q: Can we go surfing on the tour?
faqs.a: Yes. Selong Belanak has gentle waves for beginners. Tell us when you book and we can arrange board rental or a lesson.

faqs.q: Where can you pick us up?
faqs.a: Anywhere in Lombok, including Senggigi, Mataram, Kuta and Lombok International Airport.

sections.h2: Pilihan armada sewa mobil di Lombok
sections.body: City car untuk berdua: Toyota Agya, Daihatsu Ayla, Honda Brio. Mobil keluarga 7 kursi: Avanza, Xenia, Ertiga Hybrid, Suzuki XL7, Xpander. Kelas premium: Innova Reborn, Innova Zenix, Toyota Fortuner. Untuk acara spesial atau tamu VIP: Toyota Alphard dengan kabin premium.
Mobil ber-AC khusus untuk rombongan Anda, sopir lokal profesional, BBM sesuai rute, tol, dan parkir di destinasi. Tanpa biaya tersembunyi. Rute bisa diubah di hari perjalanan sesuai keinginan Anda.

Pantai selatan (Selong Belanak, Tanjung Aan, Kuta Mandalika, Bukit Merese), air terjun Sendang Gile dan Tiu Kelep di Senaru, desa adat Sasak Sade dan Sukarara, serta antar ke Pelabuhan Teluk Nare atau Bangsal untuk menyeberang ke Gili Trawangan, Gili Meno, dan Gili Air.

highlights: Sudah termasuk sopir lokal profesional
BBM, tol, dan parkir termasuk
Jemput di hotel, vila, atau bandara
Armada dari city car sampai Alphard
Rute fleksibel, bisa diubah di hari H
Tanpa biaya tersembunyi

faqs.q: Berapa harga sewa mobil di Lombok dengan sopir?
faqs.a: Di FIRST-LOP, sewa mobil dengan sopir mulai $40 per hari untuk city car. Mobil 7 kursi seperti Avanza dan Xpander mulai $50 sampai $60 per hari, Innova Zenix mulai $85, dan Toyota Alphard $200 per hari.

faqs.q: Apakah harga sudah termasuk BBM?
faqs.a: Ya. BBM sesuai rute perjalanan, tol, dan parkir di destinasi sudah termasuk.

faqs.q: Bisa dijemput di Bandara Internasional Lombok?
faqs.a: Bisa. Sopir menunggu di pintu kedatangan dengan papan nama dan membantu membawa bagasi Anda.

faqs.q: Berapa lama sebelumnya harus memesan?
faqs.a: Sebaiknya 1 sampai 2 hari sebelumnya, dan lebih awal saat musim ramai (Juli sampai September dan libur akhir tahun). Pesanan di hari yang sama sering bisa, tergantung ketersediaan armada.
